# Dead repo — do not edit

This was a separate Firefox port of X Dim Mode. It is **abandoned at v1.3.1**
and kept only for history.

`../x-dim-mode` now builds both the Chrome and the Firefox package from one
source: its `build.sh` patches the manifest for Firefox on the way out. Keeping
a second manifest here is exactly what left Firefox two versions behind.

**Work in `../x-dim-mode` instead.** Nothing in this repo should be changed,
and nothing here should be treated as current.
